fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of your application created with the ID Magalu CLI (see developers.magalu.com > Primeiros passos > Criar aplicação).

fields.name: client_secret

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent of the seller at https://id.magalu.com (scopes such as open:portfolio:read/write, open:order-order:read). If ID Magalu returns a new refresh token on refresh, the runtime keeps it (and saves it with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR).

config_fields.name: channel_id
config_fields.help: Sales channel id the stock applies to (GET /seller/v1/portfolios/me returns channel.id).

adapter.terms: Magalu (Magazine Luiza) seller APIs. Portfolio writes are asynchronous (202 with a trace_id). Prices are integers with a normalizer (e.g. 1999 with normalizer 100 = R$ 19,99).

me.note: portfolios_v1_get_me: {tenant: {id}, channel: {id, name}, seller: {id, name}} of the authenticated seller.

set_inventory.note: portfolios_v1_patch_stocks PATCH /seller/v1/portfolios/stocks/{sku} {channel: {id}, type: AVAILABLE, quantity} sets the available stock of your SKU (`sku` required) on the configured channel. Asynchronous (202 + trace_id).

end_listing.note: portfolios_v1_patch_skus PATCH /seller/v1/portfolios/skus/{sku} {active: false} deactivates the SKU (partial update; reversible with active: true). `listing_id` is your SKU. Asynchronous (202 + trace_id).

list_orders.note: seller_v1_get_order_list ?status(new|approved|...)&purchased_at__gte(ISO-8601 with offset)&_offset&_limit, newest first. `id` is the platform order code. amounts.total is an integer to be divided by amounts.normalizer, so it is left in raw rather than mapped to `total`; deliveries (needed to ship) are in raw.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /seller/v1/portfolios/skus needs category, brand, condition, dimensions, images and fiscal data (ncm, origin), and prices are created separately; the vocabulary lacks category, brand and dimensions.
not_offered.update_listing: Prices (PATCH /seller/v1/portfolios/prices/{sku}) are integers with a normalizer (price 1999 + normalizer 100 = 19.99) plus channel and currency; converting the vocabulary's decimal price needs arithmetic the adapter lacks, and a text-only SKU patch would leave the declared price unchanged.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Shipping is per delivery: POST /seller/v1/deliveries/{id}/shippings after an NF-e is attached (/deliveries/{id}/invoices); the delivery id and invoice are not vocabulary inputs.
